images.caption: Front of a former gas station (now a convenience store) located on the northwestern corner of the intersection of State Route 49 and Jackson Street in Wren, Ohio, United States.

place.source_title: Wren's Quick Stop (former gas station), SR 49 & Jackson St

brief: Small one-storey brick filling station of the 1950s turned convenience store: hipped roof, plate-glass front, a flat canopy over the old pump island, and a tall pole sign by the road. Ice chest and propane cage by the door. Record gap: 1 photo only.

facade.notes: Wren's Quick Stop (Wren OH, 1950s): a small hip-roofed filling station with a projecting canopy over the former pump island, white-painted piers, clapboard and plate glass, a lower red-sided addition; a round pole sign, a gravel apron, holiday garlands on the utility pole -- a village gas station turned convenience store

why.note: the house-type filling station: a little cottage so it would fit in a residential street, the canopy over the pumps
